multiRepoAgentControlCenter.daemonPort.description: Fixed port for the daemon's MCP HTTP endpoint. 0 = pick a random free port the first time the daemon starts and remember it here, so it stays the same across restarts/reboots instead of invalidating every registered .mcp.json each time. Only change this yourself if you see a port-conflict error — set it to any other free port and restart the runner.
